subject: catalog_count
claim: abstract：The rule: reliable methylation read-clustering exists at 12,868 loci but is overwhelmingly germline-allelic; genome-wide only 1/332,705 loci is a clean somatic cis-ASM, and methylation does not discriminate true from false somatic variants (four independent lines).
